# Ultrasound Assisted RF Microneedling Technology.


### Revealing That Beauty Lies Just Beyond the Surface

[ Book Your Demo ][24]

UltraVision™ takes skincare to the next level by combining two technologies into one personalized
treatment. With industry-first ultrasound visualization and unmatched precision, UltraVision™ offers
ultrasound imaging, mapping, and an exclusive Uniform RF Microneedling delivery system. Your
patients will appreciate the precise and personalized results they’ll achieve.


Personalized Treatment Settings
Ultrasound Skin Depth Precision
Colorblind Versatility
Minimal Downtime
Uniform Energy Delivery

Having UltraVision™ in my practice is one of the best decisions I’ve ever made, not only for my

not have every device in the book, it’s really a jack of all trades.

## What Makes Us Different

Since 2016, Aesthetics Biomedical® Inc. has pioneered technologies that
are **precise**, **personalized**, and **safe**.

Headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona, we’re a privately-owned company that develops and manufactures
U.S. made technologies and products that offer novel aesthetic devices, products, and services in
the global market. Our innovation center is a leader in breakthrough technologies and combination
therapies for our clients, physician network, and the aesthetic arena.

Our goal is to provide your customers with personalized, precise, and safe treatments delivering
results they will love.

## What Customer Say About

## UltraVision^{™}

There is something about UltraVision™ that is special – the downtime is significantly less than
regular microneedling. After multiple treatments, I feel like my makeup just glides over my skin.

I like to call it the Benjamin Button facial. It’s literally my go-to treatment.

**Jennifer Saviano, ABC’s The Bachelor & Bachelor in Paradise**

I recently completed my series of three UltraVision™ treatments and am thrilled with the results. I
am in my 60s but feel like my face makes me look closer to 40. As someone who has tried several
topical products and a few treatments, UltraVision™ is the one that has the most value and impact.
Some treatment areas feel smooth enough I don’t feel the need for injections. After my treatments, I
experience minimal redness that fades quickly. I plan to keep up with my treatments and hope to get
a series to focus on my eye area with the new smaller tip. This is a treatment I’d recommend to
anyone looking for a minimally invasive treatment with maximum results.

**- Karen M., 63 years old**

UltraVision™ is the first aesthetic treatment I have tried and am very happy with the results. After
each treatment, I notice my complexion appears more even and my skin feels tighter. As a busy mom, I
appreciate that there is minimal down time and I can go right back to any kid-related activities the
same day of my treatment, as long as I avoid the sun for twenty-four hours. My provider was able to
personalize the treatment settings to each area of my face and ensured I was comfortable. The
topical numbing cream made it virtually pain free and I loved how the cooling mask applied after
each treatment made for a relaxing experience.

**- Tracey T., 39 years old**

I have now had three treatments with the new device. Having had microneedling with other products
before, I thought I knew what to expect from the treatment, but this treatment was different. First,
I have had little to no redness, bruising, or tightness immediately following treatment. This was
huge, especially since I had appointments/meetings right after the treatments and did not have to
worry about the appearance of my face or having to schedule “down time”. The second difference from
previous treatments is that within two weeks of my first treatment, I noticed a difference: several
of my lines/wrinkles, especially my laugh lines, were not as deep. I could easily see the
improvement in the mirror. I recently was at my hairdresser who asked me what I had been doing, as
she, too, noticed my skin’s improvement. The treatment itself was painless, although you can
definitely feel it. All in all, I’m very happy with the results.

**- Debra P., 67 years old**

performance aesthetic equipment. Among all aesthetic machine manufacturers in China, ADSS is the
only one capable of completely independently developing power supply and control systems. ADSS
products are accumulatively exported to more than 160 countries around the world, creating great

A' Design Award, recognizing the excellent and original design work from across the globe, is one of
the highest achievements in design, a source of inspiration for award-winning designers, artists,
architects, brands and design agencies. Entry and nomination is open to all from all countries.

A' Design Award presents you with the World’s best design work at the A' Design Award Winners'
Designs Showcase. Enjoy a fine selection, the crème de la crème, if you will, in arts, architecture,
fashion, communication and product design. Discover great designers and brands whose superior design
products, projects and services inspire and advance our society.

widely regarded as one of the most exclusive social events in design industry, and is considered to
be the design industry's premier annual red-carpet event. The A' Design Award Gala is attended by
personalities from the arts, fashion, high-society, film, architecture, industry and design media.

# Leafsnap: An Electronic Field Guide

Leafsnap is a series of electronic field guides being developed by researchers from [Columbia
University][14], the [University of Maryland][15], and the [Smithsonian Institution][16]. The free
mobile apps use visual recognition software to help identify tree species from photographs of their
leaves. They contain beautiful high-resolution images of leaves, flowers, fruits, petioles, seeds
and bark.

The original Leafsnap currently includes trees found in the Northeastern United States and Canada,
and will soon grow to include the trees of the entire continental United States. The high-resolution
images in the original app were created by the conservation organization. [Finding Species][17].

This website shows the tree species included in Leafsnap, the collections of its users, and the team
of research volunteers working to produce it.

The Leafsnap UK app includes trees from the United Kingdom with species information and imagery
provided by the Natural History Museum in London. More information can be found on the [Natural
History Museum website][18].

The City College of New York developed and tested curricular materials that use the Leafsnap app to
help middle school students notice, group, and contextualize street trees in the patterns of
evolution. Curricular guide and other educational materials are available from [here][19].

## About Reszon Diagnostics

Established in 2010, Reszon Diagnostics International Sdn. Bhd. (“Reszon”) is a Malaysia-based
manufacturer and distributor of innovative **in vitro diagnostic (IVD) rapid test kits for
infectious disease detection, ****drug of abuse and pregnancy screening, point-of-care testing
devices **as well as** health monitoring devices.**

Backed by **ISO 13485:2016 quality management system** and **GDPMD certifications**, Reszon is
committed to delivering high-quality, accurate, and user-friendly diagnostic solutions for global
healthcare markets. Our products are trusted by medical professionals worldwide and are supported by
strong in-house R&D as well as strategic collaborations with commercial and academic research
partners.

For over a decade, we have honed our expertise in immunochromatographic assay development and
innovation, bringing these advancements to the commercial market. Guided by our motto, “**Reasoning
Possibilities in Life**,” we are dedicated to creating new opportunities to enhance human health.

## Premium Skincare & Cutting-Edge Derma Treatments in NYC

### BRIGHTER, HEALTHIER LOOKING SKIN IN UNDER AN HOUR.

Our mission is to provide the best skincare solutions for the results you want. Patients can look
forward to a premium environment with a cutting-edge treatment menu including injectables, lasers
and aesthetic treatments. Our team of [skincare experts][112] aim to give you a holistic approach to
great skin with one simple formula: Advanced Diagnostics; Signature Aesthetic Treatments; and
Effective Skincare.

[Learn More][113]

## SKINLAB™ SERVICES

Our goal is to take you from your consultation through your treatment in under an hour and to
deliver brighter, healthier skin. We provide a holistic and personalized approach to skincare that
includes a full range of [skincare services][114] and treatments.

### Medical Facials

Our medical facials are exclusive procedures and formulas developed by SkinCeuticals that leave you
looking your best.

**TRIBECA ESSENTIAL** – OUR CLASSIC TREATMENT FEATURING LASER GENESIS
**TRIBECA ADVANCED SIGNATURE** – OUR MOST COMPREHENSIVE TREATMENT
**SKINBRIGHT™ ** – HYDRAFACIALMD™ + CHEMICAL PEEL
**HYDRAFACIAL DELUXE**– FEATURING CUSTOM BOOSTER + LED LIGHT
**SKINFIRM™** – MICRONEEDLING + HYDRATING B5 GEL
**SKINLUXE™** – CUSTOM MASK + CE FERULIC
**SKINSMOOTH™** – LED MICROPEEL + PHYTO CORRECTIVE GEL
**SKINCLEAR™** – MICROPEEL + BLUE LED LIGHT

[Learn More About Medical Facials][115]

### Injectables

Soft-tissue fillers are injected into the skin to temporarily restore facial volume, fill fine
lines, or enhance facial contours.

**BOTOX, XEOMIN, or DYSPORT** – Reduce or diminish facial wrinkles and creases
**JUVEDERM®** – Add volume to plump lips, smooth lines, or lift & contour cheeks
**KYBELLA®** – Enhance facial contouring and minimize a double chin
**PRF PLATELET RICH FIBRIN** – Treat texture, acne scars, hyperpigmentation, fine lines, and
wrinkles
**SCULPTRA®** – FDA-approved, non-invasive treatment that addresses the underlying cause of facial
aging

[Learn More About Injectables][116]

### Skin Tone & Tightening

**[CHEMICAL PEELS][117]** – Exfoliating treatments that resurface the uppermost layer of the skin
[**DERMAPLANING**][118] – Anti-aging/anti-blemish exfoliating
[**INTENSE PULSATING LIGHT**][119] – Photorejuvenation or photofacial treatment designed to reduce
visible skin damage
**[LASER GENESIS][120]** – Laser treatment that evens out skin tone and texture and reduces fine
lines and acne
**[MORPHEUS8][121] **– Radiofrequency with microneedling depths that create collagen to firm and
reduce laxity
[**PDO THREAD LIFT**][122] – Non-surgical facelift that includes progressive rejuvenation techniques
[**ULTHERAPY**][123] – Non-invasive procedure used to jumpstart collagen production

### Custom Skincare

A professional service that combines high-potency ingredients with professional expertise to create
individualized skin care.

**SKINSCOPE** – LED diagnostic designed to assess skin and identify concerns
**COMPLIMENTARY CONSULTATIONS** – Our education at SkinLab is always complimentary. Schedule time to
learn about your skin, what products are right for you, or how to tackle any skin concerns.
**COSMETIC DERMATOLOGY** – Led by renowned board-certified dermatologist, Dr. Georgina Ferzli,
patients can receive expert skincare in a comfortable and accessible environment.

# Effiziente und systemische Klima- und Energielösungen

Über uns

## Viessmann steht für Erfahrung, Qualität und Innovation

Innovationskraft ist der Schlüssel zur Zukunft. Deshalb arbeiten wir seit über 100 Jahren Tag für
Tag daran, die Grenzen des technisch Möglichen neu zu definieren – für unsere Kunden, unsere Partner
und zukünftige Generationen.

[ Mehr über unsere Marke erfahren ][58]

Lösungen mit System

## Wir setzen auf ein intelligentes Portfolio

Heizen, Kühlen, Lüften und Strom erzeugen – mit unseren Energie- und Klimalösungen für Neubau und
Modernisierung verfolgen wir einen ganzheitlichen Ansatz. Intelligente Systemkomponenten sowie
digitale Services gewährleisten hohe Effizienz und Komfort.
* #### Wärme und Strom
  
  Unsere Energie- und Heizlösungen für Wohngebäude gewährleisten ein perfektes Zusammenspiel von
  Wärme und Strom. Das gilt für klassische sowie regenerative Technologien.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][59]
  [Das Bild zeigt Viessmann Produkte, einen Mann und eine Frau.]
* #### Klimaanlagen
  
  Optimales Raumklima und hohe Luftqualität – seit 2023 rundet der Bereich Klimaanlagen das
  Viessmann Climate Solutions Produktportfolio ab. Modernste Technologie vereint Effizienz und
  Komfort.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][60]
  [Das Bild zeigt Viessmann Vitoclima 300S Klimagerät an der Wand montiert]
* #### Lüftung
  
  Einzelne Räume oder gesamte Gebäude – unsere Lüftungssysteme gewährleisten einen geregelten
  Luftaustausch. Das wirkt sich positiv auf Luftqualität und Gebäudesubstanz aus.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][61]
  [Das Bild zeigt das Ventilation system und ein Mädchen]
* #### Gewerbe und Industrie
  
  Planung, Installation und Wartung – für unsere Kunden entwickeln wir maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für
  eine wirtschaftliche Versorgung mit Wärme, Dampf und Strom.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][62]
  [Das Bild zeigt eine Industrieanlage im Hintergrund und ein Tablet mit Daten im Vordergrund.]
* #### Digitale Services
  
  Steuerung, Inbetriebnahme und Wartung – unsere digitalen Services ebnen den Weg zu noch mehr
  Effizienz und erleichtern sowohl unseren Kunden als auch unseren Partnern den Alltag.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][63]

Unsere Herangehensweise an globale Nachhaltigkeitsherausforderungen basiert auf unserem Zweck, eine
lebenswerte Energiezukunft zu sichern. Dabei konzentrieren wir uns auf das Klima und viele andere
Nachhaltigkeitsfragen.

Verantwortung zu übernehmen und im Team zu denken, sind wesentliche Bestandteile unserer
Unternehmenskultur. Das zeigt sich auch in unserem Engagement im Sportsponsoring. Seit 1993
unterstützen wir Athleten, Funktionäre sowie Verbände und pflegen enge Partnerschaften.

Unser regionaler Hauptsitz ist Allendorf (Eder) in Nordhessen aber wir sind global aktiv. Unsere

Versorgung mit Wärme, Kälte, Luft und Energie.

## Beijing ADSS Development Co.,Ltd

Beijing ADSS Development Co., Ltd.(ADSS) established in July 2005, is the pioneering medical &
aesthetic laser equipment manufacturer and national high-tech enterprise specializing in R&D,
manufacturing, sales, and service of medical aesthetic equipment. Covering a total area of
160,000㎡, headquartered in Beijing with branches around the world, ADSS owns the world-class top
production and research base, located in the scenic Gu'an Industrial Park. ADSS has ranked No.1 in
the annual export volume and the total output value of medical aesthetic equipment in the field of
optoelectronics in China and is listed among the most influential medical aesthetic machine
manufacturers globally.

Based on the latest cutting-edge technology in the industry, with professional R&D capabilities as
the core, ADSS has been deeply involved in the aesthetic industry for more than 20 years and is
committed to providing customers with more cost-effective, safety-guaranteed, and more stable
performance aesthetic equipment. Among all aesthetic machine manufacturers in China, ADSS is the
only one capable of completely independently developing power supply and control systems. ADSS
products are accumulatively exported to more than 160 countries around the world, creating great
value for millions of customers !

University][14], the [University of Maryland][15], and the [Smithsonian Institution][16]. The free
mobile apps use visual recognition software to help identify tree species from photographs of their
leaves. They contain beautiful high-resolution images of leaves, flowers, fruits, petioles, seeds
and bark.

The original Leafsnap currently includes trees found in the Northeastern United States and Canada,
and will soon grow to include the trees of the entire continental United States. The high-resolution
images in the original app were created by the conservation organization. [Finding Species][17].

of research volunteers working to produce it.

provided by the Natural History Museum in London. More information can be found on the [Natural
History Museum website][18].

help middle school students notice, group, and contextualize street trees in the patterns of
evolution. Curricular guide and other educational materials are available from [here][19].

## About Reszon Diagnostics

Established in 2010, Reszon Diagnostics International Sdn. Bhd. (“Reszon”) is a Malaysia-based
manufacturer and distributor of innovative **in vitro diagnostic (IVD) rapid test kits for
infectious disease detection, ****drug of abuse and pregnancy screening, point-of-care testing
devices **as well as** health monitoring devices.**

Backed by **ISO 13485:2016 quality management system** and **GDPMD certifications**, Reszon is
committed to delivering high-quality, accurate, and user-friendly diagnostic solutions for global
healthcare markets. Our products are trusted by medical professionals worldwide and are supported by
strong in-house R&D as well as strategic collaborations with commercial and academic research
partners.

For over a decade, we have honed our expertise in immunochromatographic assay development and
innovation, bringing these advancements to the commercial market. Guided by our motto, “**Reasoning
Possibilities in Life**,” we are dedicated to creating new opportunities to enhance human health.
